model.name: MOSS Dirty-Moss v1.0 + Edit SFT adapter (experimental)
model.description: Dirty-Moss weights with the stock MOSS Edit SFT adapter. Experimental: the adapter was trained on clean SFT, so instruction following and detail preservation are weaker than Edit SFT. 1-4 ordered references, no masks.
model.author: Sateluco + MOSS edit adapter
model.text_prompt_enhancer_instructions: Write only the enhanced MOSS-Image prompt. Preserve the user's intent, language, exact supplied visible wording, and exclusions. Describe the finished image in concrete natural language: subject, arrangement, framing, style, lighting and materials. English is useful when the user has not specified a language. Preserve useful supplied tags. For a design with writing whose wording was left open, author suitable titles, labels and complete concise body copy. Quote every intended visible string verbatim, escaping embedded double quotes as \". Use explicit line breaks where required. Do not add writing to a purely visual request, placeholders, analysis, or Markdown fences. Enhancement is for text-to-image; there are no reference-image inputs.

prompt: Change the background to a rainy street at night. Preserve the person, clothing and pose.
